title: MONOLITH VS MICROSERVICES
subtitle: Splitting an app into services is an organisational decision with technical costs.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

blocks.text: In-process calls and one transaction, or independent deploys and scaling at the cost of network calls and sagas.
Instances register and heartbeat; callers look them up; sidecars handle retries, timeouts, mTLS and metrics.

items: A team must deploy on its own schedule
Events for side effects, sync only when needed

blocks.text: "I would start as a modular monolith with Postgres. The one thing I split out on day one is transcoding, because it needs GPUs and scales with uploads. Module boundaries become service boundaries when the org grows."
